_comment: Adventurers (adventurers/Adventurers.PlayerBots.js): a few named bots that start as new accounts and play on their own, training toward the quests below and completing them. Their progress is saved. quests: the order they take quests in, by the quest's name as registered on this server; skills and quests are extra requirements on top of the cache's quest table (Quests.PlayerBots.js), combat a recommended combat level. Every other quest on the server follows, easiest first. A quest is done only where a bot playthrough is built (playthrough: true); nothing is simulated, so without one they skip it. trainMinutes / questMinutes: how long one stretch lasts. questChance: the chance to pick a quest when one is ready. groupChance: the chance an adventurer takes the others along (Wintertodt together, or the same training spot). dropValue: the lowest value (coins) of a drop that goes in the drop log. bossLevel: the lowest combat level of a kill that goes in the boss log. bosses: the bosses adventurers fight from their combat level, in the boss's shared lair (x, y: where they arrive); bossChance: the chance to go bossing when one is open to them, alone or with the others. generation: raise it to start every adventurer over (levels, items, quests and journal reset, with the Tutorial Island starter kit). grandExchange: where they sell (the Grand Exchange's centre). keepValue: goods worth less than this stay in its bag between stretches (otherwise it sells them first); fullSlots: or when this few slots are free. Coins only come from sales and finds (adventurers/Trade.PlayerBots.js).
